label: Wall Jump
description: Jump off walls to reach higher platforms

parameters.label: Vertical push (px/frame)
parameters.help: Upward force of the wall jump kick in pixels per frame. When set, it overrides the legacy 8.8 Wall jump power below.

parameters.label: Wall jump power
parameters.help: Legacy vertical impulse in 8.8 fixed point (256-2048). Ignored when Vertical push is set.

parameters.label: Horizontal push (px/frame)
parameters.help: Horizontal velocity away from wall after wall jump.

parameters.label: Wall slide speed (px/frame)
parameters.help: Max fall speed while clinging to wall. 0 = instant drop.

parameters.label: Require key release between wall jumps
parameters.help: Player must release jump key before triggering another wall jump.
